Title: Jim Cramer: Hyperscalers 'Wrecked Their Balance Sheets', But Apple Carries Twice Alphabet's Debt
Summary: Jim Cramer praised Apple's "pristine" balance sheet while criticizing hyperscalers for excessive AI data center spending, but financial filings reveal Apple carries significantly more debt than Alphabet. Despite Apple's higher debt load and negative retained earnings due to extensive stock buybacks, the market rewards it with a higher P/E ratio due to its substantial liquidity. The article questions whether Apple's balance sheet will remain pristine if it significantly increases AI infrastructure spending under its new leadership.

Title: MongoDB Inc Stock (MDB) Moved Down by 12.69% on Sep 2: What Investors Need To Know
Summary: MongoDB Inc. (MDB) stock fell by 12.69% on September 2nd despite beating Q2 expectations, primarily due to concerns over decelerating revenue growth projections for Q3, which implied a drop from 30% to 21%. Investors also reacted to elevated pre-earnings expectations and increasing infrastructure costs tied to AI development. Despite long-term analyst optimism, these factors led to profit-taking and a valuation reset.

Title: G20 live updates: Nvidia's Huang pushes for AI infrastructure in every country
Summary: The G20 Innovation Ministerial focused heavily on AI, with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang advocating for every country to build its own AI infrastructure, calling it a "great equalizer." Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick discussed impending semiconductor tariffs to encourage domestic production and claimed Canada "blew up" trade deals for political reasons, a claim refuted by Alberta Premier Danielle Smith. Other discussions included the public backlash against AI data centers and predictions of significant economic growth from AI by figures like Elon Musk.

Title: Greg Abel explains Berkshire's $37 billion Alphabet stake on CNBC
Summary: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel provided the most detailed explanation yet for the conglomerate's growing $37 billion stake in Alphabet, Google's parent company. Abel stated that Berkshire views Alphabet as a "significant player" in artificial intelligence, a perspective informed by AI adoption across Berkshire's own portfolio companies. The investment began with a $10 billion private placement 15 months ago, with an additional $17 billion added in the second quarter of 2026, making it Berkshire's third-largest equity holding.

Title: Equinix Unveils Equinix Fabric One, Redefining How Enterprises Connect Across AI, Cloud and Networking Infrastructure
Summary: Equinix has announced Equinix Fabric One, a new managed connectivity service aimed at simplifying how enterprises connect their distributed cloud, network, and AI environments. This service, leveraging open connectivity specifications from AWS and Google Cloud, will automatically orchestrate and manage connectivity. Equinix Fabric One is designed to reduce the complexity of enterprise networking in the AI era and is expected to enter beta later this year, with general availability in 2027.

Title: Uber lays off 3,300 employees as it restructures for faster growth
Summary: Uber is laying off approximately 3,300 employees, about 10% of its global workforce, as part of a restructuring effort to reduce management layers and simplify operations. The company aims to reallocate resources to its core ride-hailing, delivery, and robotaxi businesses, while also tightening remote-work policies to concentrate teams in global hubs. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi stated that the savings from these changes will be reinvested in growth, innovation, and autonomous technology.

Title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest Says Amazon Has a Potential $1 Trillion AI Business Hiding in Plain Sight
Summary: ARK Invest projects that Amazon Web Services (AWS) could become a "trillion-dollar-per-year" revenue business due to accelerating AI demand. The firm also highlights that Amazon’s AI-enhanced shopping features, particularly through Alexa, are leading U.S. consumers to spend 40% more per order. This bullish outlook is driven by surging infrastructure investments and the growth of "Agentic Commerce" in retail.

Title: Why Did Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Shares Just Tumble on Executive News?
Summary: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares tumbled after news of a senior AI researcher's departure to start a new venture, coupled with a broader reshuffle in the company's AI division. This executive news caused the stock to fall through a near-term support zone, raising questions about the company's ability to maintain its competitive edge in the AI race despite strong performance from its core search and cloud businesses. The market reaction highlights sensitivity to talent retention in the rapidly evolving generative computing sector.

Title: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc Stock (CRWD) Moved Down by 7.14% on Sep 1: Drivers Behind the Movement
Summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (CRWD) stock declined by 7.14% on September 1st due to profit-taking after a strong post-earnings rally and regulatory filings revealing executive share sales. Despite the short-term pullback, analysts suggest the company's core fundamentals remain solid with strong adoption of its Falcon platform and accelerating demand for AI security solutions. The stock faces risks from stretched valuation, substantial insider divestment, and ongoing GAAP profitability drag from R&D investments.

Title: Adobe is making its tools available in Slack
Summary: Adobe has integrated its suite of creative tools, including Firefly and Photoshop, directly into Slack through Slackbot and the Adobe for Slack MCP app. This integration allows users to access and utilize over 70 Adobe tools within their Slack conversations, streamlining workflows by enabling tasks like generating PDFs, editing images, and accessing Creative Cloud assets without leaving the chat environment. This move reflects a broader trend of creative and productivity tool providers making their functionalities available in conversational platforms like Slack, ChatGPT, and Claude to meet user demand for seamless, context-aware workflows.

Title: NetApp earnings today: AI momentum meets high expectations By Investing.com
Summary: NetApp Inc. is reporting its first-quarter fiscal 2027 results today, with analysts expecting significant year-over-year growth in EPS and revenue, though sequentially lower than the previous quarter. Investors are keenly watching whether the company can convert its numerous AI design wins into sustained revenue and grow its Public Cloud segment. The company faces high expectations following a strong prior quarter, with options data suggesting another volatile stock reaction.

Title: Gartner Warns CX AI Budgets Are Surging
Summary: Gartner's latest research reveals that customer service leaders' AI spending has jumped 38%, while overall service budgets only increased by two percent. This significant reallocation of funds indicates AI is becoming a core operating cost, forcing CX leaders to prioritize governance, demonstrate ROI, and build trust in AI solutions. The study also highlights the growing importance of AI agents and the need for robust oversight to ensure measurable business value and avoid operational and compliance risks.

Title: Microsoft's AI Datacenter Expansion: A Game Changer for the Stock?
Summary: Microsoft is expanding its AI datacenter footprint, with a new Saudi Arabia East datacenter region becoming available in November 2026, contributing to an estimated $44 billion in economic activity. This expansion is part of a broader strategy, reflected in its Q4 fiscal 2026 results which showed significant revenue growth in Azure and cloud services. While Microsoft's capital expenditures are substantial, analysts note the stock's valuation appears high compared to the industry.

Title: Waymo seeks more than $3B in first debt deal to fund growth
Summary: Waymo is seeking over $3 billion in its first debt financing deal, with lenders including Pimco, Blackstone, and Sixth Street Partners. This move aims to diversify Waymo's funding beyond equity markets to support its expansion efforts, which include increasing its fleet and managing rising AI costs. The company plans to finalize this unrated loan soon as it targets 1 million paid weekly rides globally this year.

Title: Broadcom's price sinks over 6% after releasing Q3 earnings
Summary: Broadcom's stock price dropped more than 6% after the company released its Q3 earnings report, despite exceeding consensus estimates for adjusted EPS and revenue. CEO Hock Tan expressed optimism about the company's AI semiconductor revenue, which grew significantly year-over-year and is projected to accelerate further in Q4, but investors initially reacted negatively.

Title: MapQuest surges to No. 1 in App Store after Google, Apple adopt Trump’s ‘Lake America’
Summary: MapQuest has reached the top spot in Apple's App Store after refusing to adopt President Trump's controversial renaming of Lake Ontario to "Lake America." This surge in popularity comes as Google and Apple have both implemented the name change on their respective map apps following a presidential executive order. MapQuest stated its decision was based on preserving names familiar to its users, leading to widespread support and app downloads.

Title: Waymo taps into debt markets with $3B deal with Pimco, Blackstone - report
Summary: Waymo, Alphabet Inc.'s autonomous driving unit, is reportedly close to securing its first debt financing of over $3 billion from lenders including Pacific Investment Management Co. and Blackstone Inc. This move to debt financing, advised by Goldman Sachs, comes as Waymo expands its driverless fleet and faces rising AI costs, aiming to operate 1 million paid weekly rides across 20 cities globally this year. The company previously relied on equity funding, raising $16 billion earlier this year at a $126 billion valuation.

Title: South Korea's semiconductor exports just tripled year-over-year. Is it too much of a good thing?
Summary: South Korea's semiconductor exports surged 209% year-over-year in August to a record $46.65 billion, accounting for nearly half of the country's total goods exports. This boom is largely driven by AI infrastructure demand. While positive for the economy, economists are concerned about the potential impact if this rapid growth slows down abruptly, especially given challenges in other traditional sectors and ongoing monetary policy tightening.

Title: Aurora Innovation Inc Stock (AUR) Closed Up by 7.14% on Sep 2: What Signal Does It Send?
Summary: Aurora Innovation Inc. (AUR) saw its stock price rise by 7.14% after announcing an upcoming Analyst and Investor Day to detail its scaling efforts in autonomous trucking. The company recently surpassed revenue expectations and expanded commercial agreements, contributing to renewed market optimism despite technical indicators showing mixed signals with a negative MACD.

Title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
Summary: Microsoft announced it will begin disclosing quarterly revenue for its Azure cloud business, providing more transparency about its competition with Amazon Web Services and Google. This change is part of a broader restructuring that consolidates the company's internal operating segments from three to two. CEO Satya Nadella stated that this new reporting structure will define Azure more purely as their consumption-based platform and infrastructure business, emphasizing the impact of AI on the company's products and business models.

Title: Fortinet Inc Stock (FTNT) Moved Down by 5.25% on Sep 2: Key Drivers Unveiled
Summary: Fortinet Inc (FTNT) stock dropped 5.25% on September 2, driven by sector-wide weakness in cybersecurity, sparked by Palo Alto Networks' earnings report. Premium valuations, insider selling, and technical breakdowns below key moving averages contributed to profit-taking and accelerated selling pressure. Despite the short-term pullback, Fortinet maintains strong fundamentals, including record operating margins and free cash flow.

Title: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Tests Its Uptrend As Market Pressure Builds
Summary: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is facing market pressure despite strong performance in its cloud computing division and AI product deployment. The company is navigating record capital spending, an ongoing competition case, and recent market shifts like rising Treasury yields and crude oil prices. The article delves into the various factors impacting GOOGL's stock, including its legal battles, financial performance, capital expenditure strategy, and the evolving nature of its business from advertising to cloud and AI.

Title: ATLQ Price Today: JAB Acquisition Corp I Stock Price, Quote & Chart | MEXC
Summary: This article provides detailed real-time stock information for JAB Acquisition Corp I (ATLQ) on MEXC, including its current price of $9.98, market capitalization of $283.77M, and recent price movements. It outlines the company's business as a blank check company and offers a comprehensive FAQ section addressing common investor questions about its performance, valuation, and how to trade its stock. The article also includes instructions on how to buy ATLQ on the MEXC platform.

Title: Broadcom beats expectations as AI labs double down on custom chips
Summary: Broadcom Inc. exceeded earnings and revenue expectations in its third-quarter financial report, primarily driven by its semiconductor business and increasing demand from AI labs for custom chips. Despite strong performance and optimistic long-term projections for its AI revenue, the company's stock declined due to a conservative forecast for the current quarter which fell short of Wall Street estimates. Broadcom is actively collaborating with major AI players like Google, OpenAI, and Meta, developing specialized processors to support their growing AI infrastructure needs.

Title: AEVEX Corp. Notice of October 20, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
Summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC (KSF) has announced a class action securities lawsuit against AEVEX Corp. (NYSE: AVEX), notifying investors of an October 20, 2026, application deadline to serve as lead plaintiff. The lawsuit alleges that Aevex concealed a pre-arranged plan to prematurely override a 180-day lock-up period for Madison, a major shareholder, allowing Madison to sell shares shortly after the IPO for over $200 million. Investors who purchased Aevex Class A common stock between April 17, 2026, and June 4, 2026, or pursuant to the IPO offering documents, are encouraged to contact KSF for more information.

Title: Flputnam Investment Management Co. Purchases 10,502 Shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
Summary: Flputnam Investment Management Co. increased its stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 11.5% in the second quarter, acquiring an additional 10,502 shares and bringing its total holdings to 101,666 shares valued at $59 million. The article also highlights recent positive news for AMD, including AI infrastructure collaborations and analyst optimism, alongside some negative sentiment regarding competition with Nvidia and valuation concerns. Insider selling by executives Jean X. Hu and Forrest Eugene Norrod is also detailed.

Title: PG&E, Rewiring America and Google Launch First-of-its-Kind Virtual Power Plant to Help Lower Costs for All Customers
Summary: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), in partnership with Rewiring America and Google, announced SHARE (Smart Home Assets for Reliability and Efficiency), a new Virtual Power Plant (VPP) initiative. This program aims to improve grid reliability and affordability for all customers by orchestrating a network of home batteries, smart devices, and battery-enabled heat pumps in Bay Area communities. Google is fully funding the program, which will involve deploying deeply discounted home energy upgrades and enrolling over 20,000 existing energy devices to manage rising electric demand and lower costs.

Title: PG&E, Rewiring America and Google Launch First-of-its-Kind Virtual Power Plant to Help Lower Costs for All Customers
Summary: PG&E, Rewiring America, and Google have partnered to launch a first-of-its-kind virtual power plant aimed at lowering energy costs for all customers. This initiative leverages smart home technology and aggregated distributed energy resources to enhance grid reliability and efficiency. The collaboration seeks to integrate renewable energy more effectively into the power grid, providing a model for future energy solutions.

Title: Pacific Gas And Electric Company, Rewiring America, Google, Carrier Global Corporation, Tesla, Sunrun, Renew Home, Demand Side Analytics And Encoord Launch First-Of-Its-Kind Virtual Power Plant To Help Lower Costs For All Customers
Summary: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) has launched SHARE (Smart Home Assets for Reliability and Efficiency), a Virtual Power Plant (VPP), in collaboration with several partners including Google, Carrier, and Tesla. This VPP aims to lower costs and improve grid reliability by coordinating home batteries, smart devices, and battery-enabled heat pumps. The program is funded by Google and will initially engage nearly 21,000 existing flexible energy devices, with plans for new deployments of Carrier's battery-enabled heat pumps in Bay Area communities.

Title: TiVo OS Unveils Major Platform Enhancements at IFA 2026, Expanding AI-Powered Discovery, Free Streaming, Live Sports and Interactive TV Experiences
Summary: TiVo OS announced significant platform enhancements at IFA 2026, including generative AI-powered content discovery, expanded free streaming, and enhanced live sports experiences. The company also appointed Tal Bone as senior vice president and general manager of TiVo OS, aiming to accelerate growth and deliver a simpler, more intelligent content discovery experience for consumers and device manufacturers. These updates are designed to lower costs for smart TV manufacturers and introduce interactive commerce capabilities.

Title: Nykredit A S Takes Position in Netflix, Inc. $NFLX
Summary: Nykredit A/S has acquired a new position in Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX), purchasing over 1.7 million shares valued at approximately $123.7 million in the second quarter. This move comes amidst mixed sentiment from analysts, who currently rate Netflix as a "Moderate Buy" with an average price target of $96.65, despite recent price target cuts. Institutional investors collectively own a significant 80.93% of the company's stock, while insiders have sold approximately $15.8 million worth of shares over the past 90 days.

Title: Broadcom Falls 6% as Soft Guidance Overshadows 221% AI Revenue Surge; NVIDIA Inches Higher, AMD Slips
Summary: Broadcom's stock dropped 6% after its Q4 revenue guidance missed consensus, despite a 221% surge in AI revenue, due to concerns over gross margin compression. While NVIDIA saw a 1% increase, AMD and Marvell Technology experienced declines due to worries about custom-accelerator margins, highlighting a company-specific reaction to Broadcom's report rather than a broad AI sector rerating. The market's divided response stems from whether Broadcom's margin normalization is a temporary cost for gaining market share or indicative of a structurally lower-margin business model.

Title: Elon Musk Touts a ‘Storm’ of Tesla Cybercabs in Austin, Says They Offer Better ‘Operational Efficiency’ Than Waymo
Summary: Elon Musk has promoted the upcoming launch of Tesla Cybercabs in Austin, highlighting their superior "operational efficiency" compared to Waymo's robotaxis. He shared an image indicating Cybercabs are significantly cheaper to produce ($18,000) than Waymo vehicles ($125,000). Musk also alluded to further operational efficiencies beyond cost, with an engineer noting the Cybercab's energy consumption.

Title: Oracle, Alphabet, Valero Energy And More On CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
Summary: CNBC's "Halftime Report Final Trades" featured investment recommendations including Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL), Oracle Corporation (ORCL), iShares Gold Trust (IAU), and Valero Energy Corporation (VLO). Analysts provided positive ratings and price targets for Alphabet and Valero, while Oracle is set to release its Q1 fiscal year 2027 results soon.

Title: Tesla keeps hyping robotaxis as its future. But it’s trailing rival Waymo in a field yet to prove profitable
Summary: Tesla is hosting an event for its Cybercab robotaxi service, but despite CEO Elon Musk's ambitious predictions, the company is significantly behind its rival Waymo in miles driven and market penetration. The profitability of robotaxi services, including Tesla's and Waymo's, remains unproven, and both face significant regulatory and economic challenges, such as competing with low-cost human ride-hail services and high operational costs.

Title: JFrog Moves to Secure Agentic Engineering Workflows - DevOps.com
Summary: JFrog has introduced new security capabilities for agentic engineering workflows, including zero-touch remediation that automatically steers developers to secure binary versions. The company also rolled out AI-focused security tools like AI Asset Scanning and Agent Guard, and announced support for Microsoft’s Agent Package Manager to govern AI agents' software component consumption. Additionally, JFrog Traffic Controller will block direct calls to public registries, rerouting through Artifactory with support from Cloudflare, Netskope, and Zscaler.

Title: Why Microsoft Investors Should Fear Amazon More Than Google
Summary: Microsoft's recent decision to disclose standalone Azure revenue reveals that Amazon's AWS is a much larger competitor than Google Cloud, shifting the investment focus for MSFT shareholders. Despite Google Cloud's high growth rate, Amazon holds a stronger position due to existing enterprise contracts and its new role as an alternative for OpenAI's AI workloads. Microsoft's core advantage lies in its enterprise distribution, but Amazon's AWS growth and ability to attract major AI partnerships pose a significant long-term challenge.

Title: Broadcom's AI chip bet raises questions over who foots the bill
Summary: Broadcom reported stronger-than-expected earnings, but its shares slipped due to a lower-than-forecast fourth-quarter revenue outlook. The company plans to significantly increase its AI revenue in the coming years and may offer "residual value guarantees" to AI labs, raising questions about the financial risks involved in the AI infrastructure build-out. This suggests a trend of chipmakers financially backing customers whose revenues may not yet support their extensive spending commitments.

Title: Meta Platforms Inc Stock (META) Opened Up by 4.32% on Sep 3: A Full Analysis
Summary: Meta Platforms Inc. (META) stock opened up 4.32% on September 3, outperforming its sector, driven by the resolution of multi-state teen safety litigation, new generative AI models, and agentic advertising tools. The settlement cleared a major legal overhang, allowing focus on Meta's digital advertising ecosystem and AI monetization efforts. Analysts have an average price target of $755.84, although the company faces risks from aggressive AI capital expenditure and ongoing legal liabilities.

Title: Microsoft AI’s MAI-Transcribe-2 undercuts OpenAI, Google and ElevenLabs on price and speed
Summary: Microsoft AI has released MAI-Transcribe-2, a speech-recognition model that is significantly faster, more accurate, and cheaper than competing offerings from OpenAI, Google, and ElevenLabs. Priced at just 10 cents per hour of audio, this new model cuts the cost by 72% compared to its predecessor and includes advanced features like speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and code switching. This move is part of Microsoft's strategy to build its own frontier-class AI models, reducing its dependence on OpenAI and improving its profit margins across its product ecosystem.

Title: Uber to lay off 3,300 employees as competition with robotaxis grow
Summary: Uber announced it will lay off 3,300 employees, nearly 10% of its workforce, due to increasing competition from autonomous vehicles and robotaxis. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi stated the restructuring aims to reduce management layers and organizational complexity, leading to faster decisions and reinvestment in growth. This move is Uber's largest round of job cuts since the COVID-19 pandemic, as companies like Alphabet's Waymo and Tesla's Cybercab expand their driverless services.

Title: KeyBanc reiterates Microsoft stock Overweight on cleaner Azure disclosure
Summary: KeyBanc has reiterated an Overweight rating for Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) with a $600 price target following the company's revenue segment restatement. The restatement provides clearer disclosure for Azure and improved visibility into Copilot businesses, though KeyBanc noted no major revelations. This positive outlook aligns with broader Wall Street sentiment, with analysts projecting a 12% upside potential for the company.

Title: Alphabet Stock Gains 1.7% as Gemini Price Freeze Challenges 35.6% Cloud Margin
Summary: Alphabet's stock rose 1.7% following the announcement that it would maintain current pricing for its Gemini 3.8 Flash product until the end of 2026, despite its cloud division achieving a 35.6% operating margin. This strategy aims to drive usage growth before a planned price doubling in January 2027, with investors closely watching the balance between Gemini adoption and cloud profitability. Google Cloud reported an 82% revenue increase to $24.77 billion in the June quarter, showcasing robust financial performance even as infrastructure investments lead to negative free cash flow.

Title: Macquarie Upgrades Broadcom (AVGO) Stock as Anthropic AI Business Could Top $40B
Summary: Macquarie upgraded Broadcom (AVGO) to Outperform, raising its price target to $490, due to the emerging growth driver of Anthropic's AI business. The firm projects Anthropic could purchase over $40 billion in Broadcom products by fiscal 2028, significantly offsetting potential reductions from Google's in-house chip development. Despite a strong Q3 earnings report, Broadcom's shares saw a pre-market dip, while the company maintains a Strong Buy consensus from analysts.

Title: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc Stock (CRWD) Moved Up by 4.73% on Sep 3: What Investors Need To Know
Summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (CRWD) stock rose by 4.73% on September 3, driven by positive momentum from its annual cybersecurity conference, new AI partnerships, and analyst upgrades. The company's strategic positioning, robust cloud security metrics, and strong enterprise adoption of its licensing models contributed to institutional support and investor confidence. Technical indicators also suggest a buy signal for CRWD.

Title: Cramer Warns Broadcom’s $30 Billion AI Bet Depends on a Stock You Cannot Buy
Summary: Jim Cramer highlighted Broadcom's ambitious $230 billion AI revenue target for FY2028, warning that it is heavily reliant on Anthropic, a private company. This dependence creates a significant risk for Broadcom investors, as direct exposure to Anthropic is currently impossible. Cramer suggests that an Anthropic IPO would be a critical validation event for Broadcom's AI strategy, contrasting its concentrated customer base with NVIDIA's more diversified approach.

Title: Match Group (NASDAQ:MTCH) Hits New High Despite Revenue Pressure
Summary: Match Group (NASDAQ:MTCH) has reached a new annual high driven by stronger-than-expected earnings, despite ongoing revenue pressure and changing user behavior. The company's improved profitability and moderate valuation are key factors supporting the rally, though sustained revenue growth remains a crucial long-term indicator. The evolving digital dating industry and the balance between profitability and growth will define Match Group's future market performance.

Title: Tesla unveiling new Cybercab robotaxi at exclusive Austin event. Follow along here.
Summary: Tesla unveiled its new Cybercab robotaxi at a private event in Austin, with live updates detailing the vehicle's features, safety evaluations by NHTSA, and its manufacturing process. The event showcased the two-seater, gold-colored robotaxi, emphasizing its efficiency and design for low-cost production, while also causing Tesla's stock to fluctuate due to investor uncertainty regarding the wider rollout. Despite a copyright lawsuit lingering from its 2024 unveiling, attendees got initial rides in the driverless Cybercabs, which are currently limited to a specific area in Austin with 45 units registered.

Title: Raymond James raises Ceribell stock price target on new growth drivers
Summary: Raymond James has increased its price target for Ceribell (NASDAQ:CBLL) to $29.00 from $24.00, reiterating a Strong Buy rating, due to new growth opportunities in neonates, pediatrics, and delirium applications. The firm also noted Ceribell's new products like a headband, full montage, and recorder which enhance its competitive position. Despite lagging peers year-to-date, analysts expect the stock to perform well, driven by its impressive 89% gross profit margins and recent FDA approvals for expanded use.

Title: How asynchronous tools transform team collaboration
Summary: Asynchronous collaboration tools offer flexibility and efficiency for distributed teams by allowing individuals to contribute on their own schedules. These tools, which include chat apps, collaborative document platforms, and project management software, are seeing widespread adoption and continuous evolution with new features like AI integration. Choosing the right tools involves evaluating needs, aligning with IT stacks, and planning for AI, while also establishing policies and KPIs to support asynchronous work.

Title: Citi Sees a New Catalyst for Baidu as Its AI Infrastructure Business Grows
Summary: Citi analysts have initiated a 30-Day Upside Catalyst Watch on Baidu (NASDAQ: BIDU), reiterating a Buy rating with a $166 price target. The positive outlook is driven by Baidu's growing AI infrastructure business, which saw significant revenue increases in Q2 2026, and its potential eligibility for Stock Connect, which could attract more fund flows. Despite strong AI growth, the company faces challenges from declining advertising revenue and high AI investment costs.

Title: Have Insiders Sold Crexendo Shares Recently?
Summary: Crexendo (NASDAQ:CXDO) recently saw its Senior Vice President, David Wang, sell US$163k worth of shares, reducing his holding by 4.5%. Over the last year, the biggest insider sale was by Chairman Emeritus Steven Mihaylo for US$17m, at a price well above the current share price of US$5.93. Despite these sales, insiders still own 35% of the company, valued at US$68m, but there have been no insider purchases in the last year.

Title: What businesses really need from an AI off switch
Summary: Businesses need more than a simple "off switch" for AI features integrated into their enterprise software, as turning off an AI capability doesn't always stop underlying data processing or third-party access. The article highlights the critical need for granular controls over AI features, data access, and third-party interactions, especially given that AI adoption often outpaces a company's ability to manage it. It emphasizes that contractual agreements with vendors can provide a more robust and verifiable means of control over AI usage and data handling than mere software settings.

Title: Meta Rises 4% as Muse Spark 1.3 Claims Parity With Anthropic and OpenAI
Summary: Meta Platforms' stock surged 4% after the company claimed its new AI model, Muse Spark 1.3, achieves performance parity with leading models from Anthropic and OpenAI. This claim, made without independent benchmark confirmation, marks Meta's attempt to narrow the competitive gap with rivals like Alphabet, whose Gemini platform boasts 950 million users and has driven a 60% one-year return for its stock. Investors are now watching for independent evaluations and Meta's upcoming Connect event on September 23, 2026, for further validation of the company's AI advancements.

Title: Rep. Michael A. Rulli Acquires Equinix, Inc. (NASDAQ:EQIX) Stock
Summary: Representative Michael A. Rulli (Republican-Ohio) recently purchased between $1,001 and $15,000 of Equinix, Inc. (NASDAQ:EQIX) stock on August 7th through a Merrill Lynch managed account. This acquisition follows Equinix's strong quarterly results, with revenue up 16.4% year-over-year and earnings significantly exceeding analyst expectations. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $5.16 per share and is expanding its AI and data-center footprint through strategic partnerships and acquisitions.

Title: Rezolve Ai Reports $130.8 Million H1 Revenue, Up Nearly 21-Fold
Summary: Rezolve Ai announced a significant revenue increase, reaching $130.8 million in H1 2026, marking a nearly 21-fold rise compared to H1 2025. The company's customer base expanded to over 1,640, supported by global distribution partnerships with tech giants like Microsoft, Google, TCS, and Tech Mahindra. Rezolve Ai reaffirmed its FY2026 revenue guidance of approximately $360 million, expecting a stronger second half due to seasonal trends and expanding partnerships.

Title: B. Metzler seel. Sohn & Co. AG Sells 31,445 Shares of NetApp, Inc. $NTAP
Summary: B. Metzler seel. Sohn & Co. AG significantly reduced its stake in NetApp, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTAP) by selling 31,445 shares, cutting its holdings by 43.5%. Despite this, institutional investors collectively own a substantial 92.17% of NetApp's stock. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates with an EPS of $2.58 and revenue of $2.02 billion, and raised its fiscal 2027 guidance due to demand in AI infrastructure and hybrid-cloud.

Title: Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) director makes charitable gift, still holds 9,989 shares
Summary: Alphabet director R. Martin Chavez reported a bona fide gift of 1,181 Class C shares on September 1, 2026, maintaining a direct holding of 9,989 Class C shares afterward. The transaction was a gift at $0.00 per share, not a sale, and no Rule 10b5-1 trading plan was affirmed. Chavez also holds various Class C Google Stock Units that will vest over time, subject to continued employment or Board service.

Title: Why Nvidia's 'defensive move' to acquire Hugging Face is about much more than chips
Summary: Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face is described as a "defensive move" to solidify its position in the AI ecosystem. The deal grants Nvidia closer access to millions of AI developers and a crucial open-model platform, preventing rivals from controlling this vital "real estate." Hugging Face will also provide Nvidia with insights into trending AI models and architectures, further supporting its strategy to encourage a diverse range of AI models.

Title: Tesla stock drops 6% after Cybercab launch and NHTSA probe
Summary: Tesla's stock dropped 6% following the launch of its Cybercab robotaxi and a probe by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). The NHTSA is investigating whether the Cybercab, which lacks conventional controls, was properly self-certified for public roads, while analysts raised questions about pricing, production, and operational issues. Tesla is working to compete in the robotaxi market, currently led by Waymo, and has expanded its ride-hailing network despite expectations of material revenue not arriving until at least 2027.

Title: Securities Fraud Investigation Into Alphabet Inc. (GOOG)
Summary: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz is continuing its securities fraud investigation into Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) following reports of delays in its AI model, Gemini 3.5 Pro, and significant increases in capital expenditures with a negative free cash flow. These issues led to drops in Alphabet's stock price, injuring investors. The firm is urging investors who lost money to contact them regarding potential claims.

Title: Tesla Begins Cybercab Rides in Austin as NHTSA Evaluates Rollout
Summary: Tesla has launched its two-seat Cybercab in limited areas of Austin, Texas, while the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is evaluating this new driverless vehicle activity. The Cybercab, which lacks a steering wheel or pedals, is designed to be a core component of Tesla's robotaxi network. Regulatory hurdles regarding vehicles without conventional controls may impact the broader rollout, despite Tesla's plans for extensive expansion.

Title: Bilibili stock rises amid $700M convertible notes with Tencent

Summary: The Zacks Wireless Equipment industry is projected to benefit from the ongoing deployment of 5G, cloud, and fiber networks, despite challenges like high investment costs and geopolitical conflicts. This outlook highlights three companies—Ubiquiti Inc. (UI), InterDigital Inc. (IDCC), and Unusual Machines, Inc. (UMAC)—as top picks poised to capitalize on the industry's growth due to their strong product portfolios, market positions, and favorable earnings outlooks. The industry, which has outperformed the S&P 500, is expected to thrive from increased IoT proliferation, fiber densification, and evolving cloud services.

Title: Zscaler Went From 100x Earnings to 40x. Here’s What Changed.
Summary: Zscaler's net new ARR growth, excluding Red Canary, accelerated to 17% year over year in fiscal Q4, but FY27 guidance suggests a slowdown to low single digits. Deferred revenue growth has consistently decelerated since FY22, now growing slower than revenue itself, and free cash flow margin is compressing due to elevated capital expenditures. Despite these concerns, Zscaler's forward P/E multiple has already fallen significantly from 100x to 40x, indicating that much of the growth slowdown may already be priced into the stock, with new AI security products serving as a potential swing factor.

Title: Applovin Corp Stock (APP) Moved Down by 3.35% on Sep 18: What Investors Need To Know
Summary: AppLovin Corp (APP) stock declined by 3.35% on September 18 due to derivative-driven market mechanics, sector valuation recalibration, and company-specific headwinds like analyst price target reductions and legal uncertainties. The company faces execution risks with its expansion into e-commerce advertising, competitive pressures, and ongoing shareholder class-action lawsuits, despite maintaining a strong financial baseline with $5.48 billion in annual revenue and $3.33 billion in net profit. Technical indicators show a neutral to sell condition, and media coverage is low.

Title: How do you see AI reshaping your industry over the next 3 years?
Summary: Matt Ryan, Chief Marketing and Technology Officer at Harley-Davidson, Inc., discusses how AI will reshape the industry over the next three years, focusing on enhancing customer experience rather than replacing human connection. He highlights AI's role in improving manufacturing quality, streamlining operations for employees and dealers, and creating engaging experiences like animating historical archives at the Harley-Davidson Museum. Ryan emphasizes that AI's success will be measured by its ability to deepen relationships and enrich experiences, rather than just automation.

Title: Equinix Plans $5B-$7B Annual Data Center Buildout as AI Demand Accelerates
Summary: Equinix plans to invest $5 billion to $7 billion annually in data center development, primarily in existing markets, driven by accelerating AI adoption among enterprise customers. The company aims for cash-on-cash returns in the low 20% range and expects to significantly increase its power capacity under development. Executives emphasized a customer-centric approach, building infrastructure where demand is visible and preparing facilities for higher-density AI workloads.

Title: Cardinal Health Targets 13%-15% EPS Growth as Specialty Momentum Builds
Summary: Cardinal Health (NYSE:CAH) projects a 13-15% adjusted EPS growth for fiscal year 2027, primarily driven by operating income growth across its business segments, and reiterates a longer-term EPS growth target of 12-14%. Specialty services, including oncology, urology, and autoimmune care, are anticipated to be a key growth engine, with BioPharma Solutions aiming for $1 billion in revenue by fiscal 2028. The company also plans $1 billion in share repurchases and expects contributions from at-home solutions and recent acquisitions, while managing the recovery of its medical-products division.

Title: Have Insiders Sold Rocket Pharmaceuticals Shares Recently?
Summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: RCKT) recently saw its General Counsel, Martin Wilson, sell US$256k worth of shares, representing an 11% reduction in his holding. While this was the largest insider sale in the past year, insiders have sold more shares than they have bought overall. Despite insiders owning about 4.0% of the company, Simply Wall St suggests caution due to the selling activity and advises investors to consider potential risks.
